claim_boundary: A Gaussian-broadened representation of one printed 8x8x8 NSCF eigenvalue sample only; it is distinct from the separate dos.x table and establishes no numerical convergence.
energy_reference: epsilon_nk minus Fermi energy printed by rerun nscf-full.out
weight_convention: QE-printed weights are used without renormalization; their 512-point sum is approximately 2 because the non-spin-polarized output carries spin-degenerate weighting.
